executionBoundary.notes: Remote orchestration is centralized in SEIS Agent. Local tools are helper candidates.

seis-agent.description: Single remote orchestrator for policy checks, governance, and cross-tool coordination.

openai.description: Local/proxy-friendly helper for policy-oriented local reasoning.

codex.description: Primary repository execution helper when explicitly requested; SEIS Agent keeps policy authority.

antigravity.description: Antigravity 2.x desktop surface for AI-native workspace sessions; repo truth stays in Git.

antigravity-ide.description: Preferred agentic IDE surface for opening SEIS repo/worktrees when an IDE is requested.

cursor.description: Secondary AI editor for focused review or editing when explicitly selected; one writer remains active.

xcode.description: Apple platform IDE for Swift, SwiftUI, signing, simulator, and macOS/iOS build workflows.

ollama.description: Fallback lane for local/offline and private drafting.

qwen.description: Alternative local reasoning helper for cross-checks.

opencode.description: Terminal coding helper; SEIS keeps orchestration authority.

hermes.description: Agent gateway and MCP-oriented helper for bounded local orchestration.

goose.description: General automation agent helper for desktop/local agent experiments.

open-design.description: Agent-native design and prototype helper surfaced through the Open Design desktop app.

routingRules.keyword: open design|opendesign|design artifact|visual prototype|design system preview

notes: SEIS Agent is the only remote lane by policy.
Local helpers are never promoted to remote; they return to SEIS Agent for orchestration.
